deviations: Added WireFault::TruncateBody alongside DropEmbeddedByte in sc-jev and sc-jev-backends (test-util only). The no-body-bytes test needs an unparseable wire body through the public seam.

The dry-run record now carries RunConfig::mode (default Independent) instead of a constant ChainContext. real_dry_run in tests/run_response.rs sets ChainContext so the pinned r-2 fixtures stay byte-identical.

A real run cannot equal the test_builder fixture session_save_failed.json byte for byte (it records attested digests and a different mode). The test asserts the fixture's warnings entry, session_saved = false, session_id = null and the kept answers.
A chain-context refusal, or a request that cannot be built, is Failed in results with attestation NotSent and no log event. A sent backend that fails is Failed with one log event.
Haiku and Luna recover the digest before the token-count request, which is their first send. The seeded fault applies to the judge message body only.
equal_input::same_bytes was already gone from the tree in r-1. I removed RunAttestation::uniform instead.
These implementation notes, with each deviation mapped to its requirement or ADR, are in the sprint doc's Implementation notes section.
deferrals: r-3b: sc-ai --chain-context and --scripted-answers, partial-failure stdout/stderr/exit 2, the Python chain_context kwarg and JevError.response, and the .pyi. The ADR-SAG-0025 consumer-output bullet, its Status-line clause and the index-row clause stay Proposed (r-3b).
Parallel fan-out of backends, D9 and r-5 are untouched.
